answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 629 Country: India Title: Is Income or commission of insurance advisor is halaal or haram? Question: Is Income or commission of insurance advisor is halaal or haram? Give sugestions for your answers. Answer ID: 629 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 657/J) Insurance comprises of interest and gambling which are absolutely Haram in Islam. Therefore, the earning or commission of insurance advisor is not Halal; since it is helping in sin, as the Holy Quran says: but help ye not one another in sin and rancour: fear Allah; for Allah is strict in punishment. (Surah Maaidah, 5/2) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
